prompt: As countries develop, more and more people buy and use their own cars. Does the advantage of this for individuals outweigh the disadvantage for the environment?
essay:
It is often argued that private vehicle ownership is becoming more common nowadays. While this issue has some advantages for people and disadvantages for the environment, I believe that the drawbacks are more significant.

There are several advantages for people associated with this matter. One of the main benefits is that using a private car offers a faster commuting method. This means that people do not need to spend an excessive amount of time commuting, which can have a positive impact on their living standards. Another positive point is that travelling by a private car is more flexible. This is particularly beneficial because it can make the trip more pleasant and comfortable. For example, passengers can stop the vehicle whenever they want to enjoy nature and take some rest.

On the other hand, the drawbacks of this matter for the environment are more significant. One major disadvantage is that the number of cars on the streets increases, which can negatively affect air quality due to higher levels of emissions released by the cars. In addition, increasing demand for road network expansion is another negative point. If this trend continues, it is likely to lead to the damage of a larger number of wild animals’ habitats. For instance, if a new road is built because of the increasing number of private vehicles, some parts of the natural environment must be destroyed. 

In conclusion, although this issue has both advantages and disadvantages, I believe that its cons outweigh the pros because they have more widespread and long-lasting impacts, particularly in terms of air quality and habitat destruction.
